mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 1 THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND txn_date > LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{yearMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'))

SELECT CEIL((DAY(t.txn_date) + DAYOFWEEK(DATE_FORMAT(t.txn_date, '%Y-%m-01')) - 1) / 7) AS weekNo, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM transaction t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.txn_type = 0 AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(t.txn_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY weekNo ORDER BY weekNo

SELECT CASE DAYOFWEEK(t.txn_date) WHEN 1 THEN '일' WHEN 2 THEN '월' WHEN 3 THEN '화' WHEN 4 THEN '수' WHEN 5 THEN '목' WHEN 6 THEN '금' WHEN 7 THEN '토' END AS dayOfWeek, SUM(t.amount) AS amount FROM transaction t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.txn_type = 0 AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(t.txn_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY dayOfWeek ORDER BY FIELD(dayOfWeek, '일', '월', '화', '수', '목', '금', '토')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN SUBSCRIPTION s ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id JOIN deposit_account d ON s.deposit_id = d.deposit_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND p.paid_at BETWEEN CAST(CONCAT(REPLACE(#{yearMonth}, '-', ''), '01') AS UNSIGNED) AND CAST(CONCAT(REPLACE(#{yearMonth}, '-', ''), '31') AS UNSIGNED)
